lines.text: Two notes meet in the hall. One is gone in a single tick. The other waits, and waits, for two.
Clara wonders why the slow one is called a minim, which sounds rather small.
A true story from music history.
Seven hundred years ago the minim was one of the shortest notes there was. Its name comes from the Latin minima, the smallest.
Over the centuries composers kept inventing shorter notes, the old ones grew slower and slower, and the name stayed behind. Now the minim is one of the long ones.
A crotchet is one tick. A minim waits for two.
